Card Q&A.a: This is a specific rule that allows you to include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly?(*This card's "You can include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck" has been changed to "(Rule) You can include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck")

Effect: You can include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck.
[When Attacking] You may play 1 level 5 or lower [Eosmon] from your hand without paying its memory cost.
